options.name: apcu_autoloader
options.description: Uses APCu to cache found/not-found classes.

options.name: arguments
options.description: Composer arguments like required package, version and so on.

options.name: classmap_authoritative
options.description: Autoload classes from classmap only. Implicitly enable optimize_autoloader. Recommended especially for production, but can take a bit of time to run.

options.name: command
options.description: Composer command like V(install), V(update) and so on.

options.name: composer_executable
options.description: Path to composer executable on the remote host, if composer is not in E(PATH) or a custom composer is needed.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to PHP executable on the remote host, if PHP is not in E(PATH).

options.name: force
options.description: When O(command) is V(create-project), the module checks whether a V(composer.json) already exists in O(working_dir) and skips the command if it does, making the task idempotent. Set to V(true) to always run the command regardless.

options.name: ignore_platform_reqs
options.description: Ignore C(php), C(hhvm), C(lib-*) and C(ext-*) requirements and force the installation even if the local machine does not fulfill these.

options.name: no_dev
options.description: Disables installation of require-dev packages (see C(--no-dev)).

options.name: no_scripts
options.description: Skips the execution of all scripts defined in composer.json (see C(--no-scripts)).

options.name: optimize_autoloader
options.description: Optimize autoloader during autoloader dump (see C(--optimize-autoloader)). Convert PSR-0/4 autoloading to classmap to get a faster autoloader. Recommended especially for production, but can take a bit of time to run.

options.name: prefer_dist
options.description: Forces installation from package dist even for dev versions (see C(--prefer-dist)).

options.name: prefer_source
options.description: Forces installation from package sources when possible (see C(--prefer-source)).

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Directory of your project (see C(--working-dir)). This is required when the command is not run globally. This is ignored if O(global_command=true).
